input.description: A public website exposed a spreadsheet containing participant names, home addresses, medical notes, and emergency contact details for several days.
A membership list was emailed to an unintended external recipient. The report does not state which fields were included, whether the recipient deleted it, or whether affected people were notified.
An unencrypted laptop containing background-check documents and participant identity records was lost on public transport and has not been recovered.
A coordinator shared event photographs in a partner newsletter. The report is unclear about consent, whether minors appear, which audience received it, and whether removal was requested.
